basis.en: Separate form study informed by the cited boat’s outline and photographs. These station offsets remain reconstructed; an authenticated section survey is still required.
basis.mt: Studju separat tal-forma ggwidat mill-profil u r-ritratti tad-dgħajsa ċċitata. L-offsets huma rikostruwiti; għadu meħtieġ stħarriġ awtentiku tat-taqsimiet.

frameBasis.en: Unequal demonstration spacing; neither frame count nor individual positions are authenticated. Replace with a specimen’s numbered frame survey or attributed galvu record.
frameBasis.mt: Spazjar mhux indaqs għal tagħlim; l-għadd u l-pożizzjonijiet mhumiex awtentikati. Jeħtieġ stħarriġ tal-majjieri nnumerati jew rekord attribwit ta’ galvu.

citations.locator: Boat-specific profile illustrations and construction discussion

scope.en: Supports the stated form or specimen observations, not these numerical offsets.
scope.mt: Jappoġġa l-forma jew l-osservazzjonijiet tal-eżemplar, mhux dawn l-offsets numeriċi.
